about_blocks.text: Field Trip Health Vancouver is a premier treatment center that specializes in Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) for individuals struggling with mental health disorders. MAT is a clinically-proven approach to treating addiction and mental health disorders. It involves using medications to help curb cravings and alleviate symptoms, coupled with intensive therapy sessions to help patients address the root cause of their issues.

about_blocks.text: At Field Trip Health Vancouver, we use ketamine-assisted therapy to help patients overcome issues like anxiety, depression, and PTSD. Ketamine is a powerful hallucinogenic drug that has been found to have therapeutic benefits for mental health patients. Our team of medical and mental health experts oversee your therapy sessions and offer personalized treatment plans to ensure that you get the best possible care.

about_blocks.text: Field Trip Health is a reputable rehab center that offers safe and legal ketamine-assisted therapy to individuals suffering from treatment-resistant mental health conditions such as depression, anxiety, and PTSD in Vancouver. Their treatment protocol combines ketamine therapy with guided talk therapy sessions which are supervised by a team of medical and mental health professionals. By implementing evidence-based and medically-supervised psychedelic-assisted therapies, Field Trip provides an effective solution to individuals struggling with mental health disorders who have not responded to traditional treatments.
